frozenNotice: Dieses Addendum steht NEBEN dem Basis-Datensatz UND neben dem ersten Addendum. Weder das eine noch das andere wird editiert, neu gesiegelt oder aufgehoben (LR-16). Es registriert ausschliesslich den durch die G7-Vollendung veraenderten Modul-SHA neu.

authority.scope: Den ausfuehrbaren Anker des Einzel-Appenders nach der G7-Vollendung neu registrieren. G7 fuehrt LEDGER_RELS als geordnete Menge und prueft Mitgliedschaft statt Gleichheit; der Modul-SHA des Basis-Ankers ist dadurch veraltet.

module.sha256Basis: SHA-256 over the file bytes with CRLF normalised to LF; this path is not pinned to LF by .gitattributes, so a Windows checkout must not decide the verdict.
module.decisionRule: Look at what the head added since it forked off base (three-dot range). If the ledger is not among those paths there is nothing to judge. If it is, the range must contain the ledger and NOTHING else - the ledger-only mini-PR the base record's branchWorkSequence prescribes.
module.rangeWideNotPerCommit: Deliberate. Splitting the append into its own commit inside a study branch is the obvious evasion; a per-commit check would wave it through. The probe executes that evasion and shows it caught.
module.failsClosed: A guard that cannot run says so. resolveBaseRef rethrows anything that is not a plain 'ref does not exist' miss, and checkSingleAppender refuses a backslash-joined ledgerRel instead of returning a clean verdict for the wrong reason.

probe.sha256Basis: SHA-256 over the file bytes with CRLF normalised to LF.
probe.kind: executed sabotage probe on a hermetic temporary git repository; the real ledger on main is never touched and nothing is pushed from the sabotage branch
executedProbes: T172 probe: an executed branch-side ledger append is CAUGHT
T172 probe: splitting the append into its own commit does not buy an escape
T172 probe: chain check and git-prefix anchor are BLIND to that same append
T172 probe: the clean branch and the prescribed mini-PR stay GREEN
T172 probe: the guard refuses to run blind
T172: the live checkout carries no branch-side ledger append
probe.bothDirections: The probe pins red AND green: the violation is caught, and the two legitimate shapes (a branch that never touches the ledger, and the prescribed ledger-only mini-PR) stay green. A guard that only ever fires proves nothing about the route it is supposed to permit.
